questions.stem: What is the index form of the product 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2?
questions.solution: The product 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 can be written as 2 raised to the power of 5, which is 2^5. The other options are incorrect because they do not match the number of times 2 is multiplied.

hi.solution: 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 के गुणनफल को 2 के 5 घात के रूप में लिखा जा सकता है, जो कि 2^5 है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे 2 के गुणन की संख्या के साथ मेल नहीं खाते।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate use of Hindi mathematical terminology.

questions.stem: Which of the following represents the square root of 25 in index form?
questions.solution: The square root of a number is equivalent to raising that number to the power of 1/2. Therefore, the square root of 25 is represented as 25^(1/2). The other options represent different exponents, such as squaring, cubing, or taking the reciprocal of a square, which do not correspond to a square root.

questions.stem: If (2^3)^4 = 2^x, what is the value of x?
questions.solution: According to the laws of indices, (a^m)^n = a^(m×n). So (2^3)^4 = 2^(3×4) = 2^12. The value of x is 12. The other options do not correctly apply the rule of exponents.

hi.solution: सूचकांक के नियम के अनुसार, (a^m)^n = a^(m×n) होता है। अतः (2^3)^4 = 2^(3×4) = 2^12 होता है। x का मान 12 है। अन्य विकल्प सूचकांक के नियम के सही अनुप्रयोग के बजाय गलत हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology as found in Hindi-medium textbooks.

questions.stem: What is the index form of the fifth root of 13?
questions.solution: The fifth root of 13 is expressed as 13 raised to the power of 1/5. The index form of a root is written as the base raised to the reciprocal of the root. 13^5 means 13 multiplied by itself five times, not the fifth root. 5^13 and 5^(1/13) do not represent the fifth root of 13.

questions.stem: Which expression represents the cube of the square root of 225?
questions.solution: The cube of the square root of 225 is represented as 225^(3/2). (225^(1/2))^3 is equivalent to 225^(3/2), but it is not the standard form. 225^3 represents the cube of 225, not the square root. 225^(1/3) represents the cube root, not the square root.

hi.stem: 225 के वर्गमूल के घन को कौन-सा व्यंजक दर्शाता है?
hi.solution: 225 के वर्गमूल के घन को 225^(3/2) द्वारा दर्शाया जाता है। (225^(1/2))^3, 225^(3/2) के बराबर है, लेकिन यह मानक रूप नहीं है। 225^3, 225 के घन को दर्शाता है, न कि वर्गमूल को। 225^(1/3), घनमूल को दर्शाता है, न कि वर्गमूल को।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology in Hindi.

mr.stem: 225 च्या वर्गमूळाच्या घनाचे व्यंजक कोणते आहे?
mr.solution: 225 च्या वर्गमूळाच्या घनाचे व्यंजक 225^(3/2) असते. (225^(1/2))^3 हे 225^(3/2) च्या समतुल्य असते, परंतु ते मानक रूप नाही. 225^3 हे 225 च्या घनाचे व्यंजक असते, वर्गमूळाचे नाही. 225^(1/3) हे घनमूळ दर्शविते, वर्गमूळ नाही.
